description: The shared preset's one monthly pull request covers the icon libraries too: .github/workflows/icons.yml rebuilds their pins and the generated files from the lockfile versions on every Renovate branch, committing as github-actions[bot]. Workflow actions are pinned by commit digest, and a release waits 3 days before Renovate proposes it.

packageRules.description: The native binding and the wasm build must stay on one version (scripts/build.mjs fails otherwise).
The eval fixtures pin images and providers on purpose: they are test inputs, not dependencies.
